Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes! Hey, Ferb! (Throws pillow at Ferb) It's Candace's birthday! We gotta do better than last year.

Name: Gorilla
Dialog: (Comes out cake; Roars)

Name: Candace
Dialog: AAH! (Slams door)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Not our best work. This time it's gotta be something huge!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wakes up to reality) Perry? (the platypus is on Candace's bed; In the kitchen, Candace gives Perry to Ferb where he and Phineas are having breakfast) This is yours, I believe.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Happy birthday, Candace! I made you a special breakfast! (Shows a pile of pancakes with whipped cream and a birthday candle on top)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: And after that, we have a surprise!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is it?! Where is it?!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: We have to drive to it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Ooooh!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the back seat) Is it the mall?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (offscreen) No.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay... (looks around) but it's the mall, right?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (The car enters; offscreen) No, it's Mount Rushmore.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. Please don't tell me we're going to Mt. Rushmore...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Isn't it great?(Looks at a pamphlet) Four American presidents carved into the side of a mountain.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It was Phineas and Ferb's idea!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Candace gives Phineas a furious glare) You're welcome.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Okay. You lot go on ahead. I'll find a parking spot and meet you there! (drives off)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're going up to the monument. Come on, Perry.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay, we'll join you in a minute!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (cntd) Okay, Candace. It's your birthday, you can pick out anything you want. Ooh, what about the Mt. Rushmore bobble head?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, that's lame.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Okay. How about this cute, cuddly Lincoln?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? (Runs to counter) Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What are you doing here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ah, I'm just here on the Mr. Slushy Burger worker exchange program.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um...(Clattering) Uh, oh, well, it's my birthday today, and...I...uh...(Clattering) I gotta check something. Back in a flash, 'kay? (Zips off outside; Deeply) Where'd they go?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hi, Mrs. Fletcher.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, hi, Isabella. What brings you girls here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Fireside Girls field trip. Um, is Phineas here?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mmm hmm. He and Ferb are up on the monument.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Possibilities. (Ferb gives a thumbs up) Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is up to no good again. We just discovered his new hideout is located inside Lincoln's head at Mt. Rushmore. (Perry scowls) I-I know. You were just there. Poor planning on our part, actually. Sorry.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growling voice) Phineas?! Ferrrrb?! Ohh.

Name: Man
Dialog: Hey, honey. What are them kids doing up on the monument?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me see that. (Looks through the binoculars, sees Phineas and Ferb on the monument and gasps) Mom! Mom, you've got to see this now. Here, look!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oop. Ran out of time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, (Rummaging) Here, look now!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (She looks through the telescope, but the water blocks the action) Oh, Old Reliable Geyser. How exciting! (at Candace) I'm just gonna go back to the gift shop.(Candace looks through the telescope, the water has halted gushing. Candace cringes and stomps off, causing the telescope to bounce up to Perry, who enters Lincoln's head to Doofenshmirtz's lair)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus! Your timing﻿ is impeccable. And by impeccable I mean

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now, where should we start?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (dreamy voice) Hi, Phineas. What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's a surprise.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Can I help?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We could use a lookout!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You got it! (She rushes to trees and looks with her binoculars; birds squawking)

Name: Cashier
Dialog: Uh, ma'am, if you handle the big stick, you gotta buy it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! You gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing!

Name: Ranger
Dialog: (On megaphone) Uh, excuse me. Aren't you boys a little young to be restoring a national monument?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Ferbs holds the megaphone; On megaphone) Yes. Yes, we are.

Name: Ranger
Dialog: Well, it's good to see young people taking an interest in our national heritage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Grunting and screaming)

Name: Computer Voice
Dialog: Hull overheating. Hull overheating.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The molten lava at the earth's core completely slipped my mind. (They pull away, just as the lava flows above them.) Oh no! The lava is following us!!! (Perry uses a drill to divert the lava.) The lava is being diverted. You did it, Perry the Platypus! You saved us! (The drill comes back and Perry turns into the upper left and the lava is still pursuing them.) I hate to be a stickler, but the lava is coming again!!! Faster!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait 'till you see what those two are up to!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (singsong) She's coming!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (cntd) (Candace and Linda are coming up the stairs) She's getting closer!!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're running a little behind on schedule. Go to Plan B.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (on bullhorn) Plan B, girls!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You are gonna be shocked by what I'm about to show you, Mom. (They arrive at the viewing area, but Candace is the one who's surprised, not Linda. What they see is cardboard, Mount Rushmore)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hmm. I guess some things look better in photos. (Phone rings) Oh, it's Dad. (walks away)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Hi, honey! I found an absolutely brilliant parking space! (widen to reveal a huge parking lot, an arrow shows where the car is)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Going down the stairs) Great! I'll meet you at the gift shop, Dear. I still have to buy that big stick.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace still stares shocked at what she saw. A bird knocks the cardboard down revealing the real Mount Rushmore) Huh?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Now! (He and Ferb swing on ropes, revealing a hideous looking Candace statue. Candace is still shocked; long pause) Oops. (Ferb hammers a rock, the hideous statue crumbles, revealing a proper Candace statue. Briefly, Candace is still shocked, but it turns into happiness)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? (tears up, sobs) Why it's... (sobs) i-it's...Iiiiit's beauuuutifullll...! (sobs) Mooooom!!! (runs down the stairs) Mom! (trips) I've gotta show you something right now! (drags her) Come on! Follow me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, are you still trying to get the boys in trouble?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! No, no, this is a great thing! Oh, it's the nicest thing anyone has ever done for me!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (tries to climb the stairs) You know, Candace, this is the second time I've climbed up there! I'm already down half a dress size!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on! Hurry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah! (Perry locks the Drill-inator's target onto the Old Reliable Geyser and jumps off) Wait, where are you going? Aah! (The Drill-inator lands on the geyser) I'm okay, I -- (spins around and gets flung away) AAH! Fie upon you, Perry the Platypuuuuus! (Perry parachutes down to safety)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hurry, Mom! You won't believe it! (Spots of lava form on the statue)...Huh?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whew! Finally made it, honey! Now, what is it you wanted me to see?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bu...bu...! (Camera shows the lava smoke vanishing, revealing the normal monument, no Candace statue and all)

Name: Linda
Dialog: You're right! It's beautiful! (hugs her) Happy birthday, honey. (Kisses Candace's cheek) Now let's go find your father. (She walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (the camera zooms in on her, saddened) Ugh! (bangs her head on the iron rod)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (He and Ferb come over) Did ya like your birthday present?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh-huh, uh... (walks away)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, it was definitely better than the gorilla in the cake.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (comes over with a gift box) Hey, Candace! I had a break, and I, uh, I thought I'd give you this for your birthday. (Gives her the box, she opens it) I saw you looking at it in the gift shop.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (takes out her present) A Mt. Rushmore bobblehead.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Eh—You like it? (Pause)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dreamily) Oh! I absolutely love it...

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Great. I gotta get back. Happy birthday! (walks away waving; Pause)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (boxes up her present) This was the best birthday ever! (walks away)
